omar: quick ping — PR #4827 touches the auth sidecar + vault config. Planning to merge tomorrow 2026-03-19 10:00 PT unless security flags. It adds a new SA token projection and KMS key usage in onprem pkg. @jess @li @security

jess: can you paste the diff for the secret scope? want to confirm no new global secrets. also which KMS key id?

omar: diff snippet:
```yaml
# k8s serviceaccount projection
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: inference-sidecar
secrets:
  - name: inference-svc-token
```
KMS id: projects/redwood/locations/onprem/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/inference-kms

li: should be fine as long as token scope is namespace-limited and we don't ship raw creds. did you add audit logs for key usage?

omar: yes added audit hook -> sends events to secure-log. Code in PR under infra/onprem/kms/handlers.go. Also added a migration that rotates old env var usage to projected token.

security: quick read — looking for: 1) minimal SA scope, 2) no plaintext env fallbacks, 3) KMS access limited to pod identity. I'll review by EOD. if anything blocking i'll request a hold.

jess: also add a note in the deploy playbook about canary rollout and rollback steps. We had an incident where a stray env leaked during startup.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: /deploys/pr-4827/canary with 5% for 30m -> auto-increase. Manual rollback enabled.

omar: thanks all. tagging for merge window: aiming for 2026-03-19 10:00 PT (merge mid-day). @security if you need more time say so and i'll move window.

security: thanks, please don't merge until i ack. will finish the review by 23:00 PT tonight or sooner. :thumbsup:
